cohort: c3-attach-held (67 official_pdf_fill families, all SOURCE_BLOCKED, each with up to three corpusCandidates)
headline: Sixty-seven of sixty-seven refused at the claim gate: the ledger holds no packet-build grant for any family in this cohort, and no source-acquisition grant for any of their 224 form obligations. I built nothing and attached nothing. I did the read-only identity work anyway, against the bytes, for all 67 candidate documents — and it overturns a large part of the cohort's premise. Every candidate's SHA-256 matches the Master Library's own custody record, so the mounted bytes are the curated bytes; but 18 of the 67 candidates must never be bound to these routes, and three more are the wrong instrument for the route that was offered them. The single most dangerous case: three North Carolina families were offered a Vietnamese affidavit of indigency whose own first line reads 'DO NOT COMPLETE THIS FORM FOR FILING'.

claimDiscipline.laneNameProblem: The brief names me FABLE-C3. claim.mjs resolves lane kind from the lane PREFIX (PF/FIX/VF/DISC/SRC/ACQ/PROMO) and dies UNKNOWN_LANE on anything else before the ledger is consulted; '--assert FABLE-C3 al-diversion-set' returns 'UNKNOWN_LANE: FABLE-C3' with exit 4. I therefore asserted under the prefixes that name the operations this task actually is: PFC3 for the packet-build operation, ACQC3 for source acquisition, SRCC3 for source reconciliation.

familyLevel.whyNoLaneNameWouldHelp: locate() dies NOT_GRANTED when NO lane of that kind holds the subject, before it ever compares lane names. Verified directly in the ledger by exact-match lookup, not by grep: data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/claim-ledger.json holds 691 claims and not one is a packet-family claim for any of these 67 ids.

sourceObligationLevel.underSourceAcquisitionLaneACQC3: NOT_GRANTED on all 224 — no source-acquisition lane holds any of them
sourceObligationLevel.underSourceReconciliationLaneSRCC3: 83 GRANTED_ELSEWHERE and 141 NOT_GRANTED. The 83 are held by DISC02-DISC06 and SRC01-SRC04. Of those, 37 are LIVE right now and 46 are released.
sourceObligationLevel.collisionRisk: 37 of this cohort's form obligations are under a LIVE discovery or reconciliation grant held by another lane. Attaching sources to those families without a grant would have collided with running lanes, not merely skipped a formality.

claimDiscipline.ledgerUnchanged: --assert is read-only. I ran no --release, --reissue or --transfer.
claimDiscipline.precedent: FABLE-C2 (commit a712d8057) and FABLE-R16, recorded in DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001 amendment A3, both refused every assigned family at the claim gate, did read-only work, and raised the finding rather than deciding it. I followed that pattern.

legalStandardRead: DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001 read in full including A1 (ask the repository first; a named checkable authority stands in only where the record is empty), A2 (the repository is every committed record the family binds plus every record the census names as a requiredSourceId), A3 (holding is per FACT, not per document; a record keyed to a different statutory section does not answer this route) and A4 (the ask-first test extends to REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, FILING_DESTINATION and SERVICE where the failure is withholding or denying something the repository establishes, and a packet may never tell a participant it does not state something it does state). No fee, service or filing-destination sentence was written to any participant, because nothing was built. A3 did real work here even so: it is the reason the Michigan MC 227a/MC 227b substitution and the California CR-401 offer are recorded as refusals rather than as near-misses.

corpusRecovery.howRecovered: The pinned release asset was already present on this machine and its SHA-256 matched the pin in scripts/rcap-corpus/bootstrap-private-corpus.sh exactly, so I extracted it locally and repeated every check that script performs — archive hash, jurisdiction/file/PDF counts, and all three individually pinned source hashes — rather than re-downloading. No corpus byte is committed; private/ is git-ignored and I confirmed that before extracting.

method.whatEstablishingIdentityMeantHere: form number printed on the face of the document, edition or revision stamp printed on the face, issuing authority named on the face, page count and page legend, form technology (AcroForm, XFA or no form dictionary), encryption and its permission flags, and SHA-256 of the exact bytes — then a comparison of all of that against the form the route names.
method.aMistakeIMadeAndCorrected: My first form-shape pass counted /Subtype /Widget in the raw bytes and in every FlateDecode stream I could inflate. That is unsound for an ENCRYPTED PDF: its streams are ciphertext, widgets are invisible, and the document reads as flat when it is not. It reported four documents as flat that are not — three California XFA forms and Maine CR-307. I re-ran the shape determination through pdfinfo, which parses the document properly and reports Form: and Encrypted:, and that is what every formTechnology value below comes from. Recording this because the same shortcut will look reasonable to the next lane.
method.custodyRecordUsed: the Master Library's own 00_GOVERNANCE/MASTER_ASSET_MANIFEST.jsonl, which already carries sha256, revision, language, structural_class, pages, source_url, source_status, freshness_status, checked_date, packet_candidate, generation_allowed and runtime_status for every asset, joined to the repo-side data/rcap-grade-a/official-source-registry.json. No new registry was created.
method.custodyResult: All 67 candidates have a manifest row and all 67 observed SHA-256 values equal the manifest's declared SHA-256. Zero mismatches. 25 carry a source URL the repository already holds and 25 are linked to a repo-side registry sourceId. The retrieval date the library records for every one of them is 2026-08-02.

theFiveFindingsThatMatterMost.finding: A translation that forbids its own filing was offered to six families
theFiveFindingsThatMatterMost.detail: Six candidates are Spanish or Vietnamese copies whose first printed line is 'NOTE: THIS FORM IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. DO NOT COMPLETE THIS FORM FOR FILING. USE THE ENGLISH VERSION ... INSTEAD.' They carry no form fields at all. They are: AOC-CV-226 VI (offered to three families), AOC-CV-226 ES, AOC-CR-288 instructions VI and ES, AOC-CR-287 instructions VI and ES. The candidate generator matched on document id and ignored the language column.
theFiveFindingsThatMatterMost.theRepair: Every one has an English edition already in the library, and I established its identity and hash below: AOC-CV-226 EN REV-2023-04 (AcroForm, 77 fields, sha 74057a13e4bccccb...), AOC-CR-288 instructions EN Rev. 3/25, AOC-CR-287 instructions EN Rev. 12/25. This is a substitution, not an acquisition.

theFiveFindingsThatMatterMost.finding: A Michigan family was offered two California forms
theFiveFindingsThatMatterMost.detail: mi_setaside_trafficking-set names 'MC 227b' and 'Proof of Service'. For the proof of service it was offered CA CR-106-INFO and CA CR-401 — Judicial Council of California documents, and CR-401 is keyed to Health and Safety Code § 11361.8 (Proposition 64). The generator matched the generic title 'Proof of Service' across jurisdictions.
theFiveFindingsThatMatterMost.theRepair: No acquisition is needed. PAGE 3 OF MC 227b IS the notice of hearing and proof of service, printed on the form itself: 'I certify that copies of this application and certified record of conviction and notice of hearing were served on the prosecuting official ... Attorney General ... Michigan State Police ...'. Read straight off the bytes.

theFiveFindingsThatMatterMost.finding: Michigan's three set-aside applications are three different statutes and are not interchangeable
theFiveFindingsThatMatterMost.detail: mi_setaside_application-set names MC 227 and was offered MC 227a (misdemeanor marihuana, MCL 780.621e) and MC 227b (human trafficking victim). MC 227b's own face carries the use note: 'If you are asking to have a conviction set aside that is not the direct result of you being a victim of a human trafficking violation, you must use MC 227.' The form refuses the substitution in its own words. MC 227 is not in the Master Library.
theFiveFindingsThatMatterMost.theRepair: MC 227 genuinely needs acquisition. This is A3 stated by the document itself.

theFiveFindingsThatMatterMost.finding: Ten candidates are files the library forbids the packet resolver from using
theFiveFindingsThatMatterMost.detail: Ten sit in 05_SOURCE_GATED. Master Library governing rule 6 reads: 'Source-gated files must never be selected by the packet resolver.' Their own manifest rows record packet_candidate=no and freshness_status=source_or_currentness_gate_open. They are MO GN10, MO CR300, MT-FORM-A, MT-FORM-B, MT-OCA-MMRTA, AZ AOCCREM2F-071221, KY AOC-497.3, ME CR-307, UT 1146XX and UT 1148XX. Six candidates are .docx word-processing files rather than official PDFs, and five of those overlap the source-gated set.
theFiveFindingsThatMatterMost.theRepair: These are not near-misses to be argued past. Either the gate is lifted deliberately and on the record, or the form is acquired from the publisher. Neither is a builder's call.

theFiveFindingsThatMatterMost.finding: The library's own structural_class is wrong for four documents, and three of those are locked
theFiveFindingsThatMatterMost.detail: CA CR-106, CA CR-106-INFO and CA CR-401 are recorded as acroform_pdf. pdfinfo reports Form: XFA for all three — Adobe LiveCycle dynamic forms — and all three are AES-encrypted with 'copy:no change:no'. ME CR-307 is AES-256 encrypted with 'change:no'. A field-name overlay written against AcroForm semantics will not fill an XFA form, and the permission flags forbid modification regardless. Separately, NE CC 6:12a instructions is recorded flat_pdf and is actually an AcroForm.
theFiveFindingsThatMatterMost.theRepair: The California trio needs an acquisition of unencrypted publisher bytes or an explicit determination about filling a form whose publisher disallows modification. This is the same class as the encryptedSources stop already recorded in STATE.json for ca-1203-4-set.

alsoWorthRecording.item: New Hampshire's two fee-waiver forms are variant editions, and one is e-filing only
alsoWorthRecording.detail: The cohort names NHJB-2311 and NHJB-2328. The faces print NHJB-2311-Se (07/01/2018) and NHJB-2328-DFPe (01/01/2018), and NHJB-2328-DFPe opens with the words 'For e-Filing only' and is titled '(eCourt)'. The court-hosted URLs the library already holds confirm both suffixes. A packet that tells a participant to file on paper must not hand them the e-filing-only asset without saying so.

The Case List form must be filed at the same time you file this Request form.' The library holds only three Illinois PDFs and the Case List is not one of them. Nine families depend on it and it is the second largest fan-out in the whole cohort.

alsoWorthRecording.detail: All seven Alabama families name CR-65 and C-10-CRIMINAL. C-10-CRIMINAL is held and its identity is clean. CR-65 — the expungement petition itself — is not in the library at all, so no Alabama family can be completed from what is held.

whatACaptainMustDecide: Whether this cohort is dispatchable at all. Sixty-seven families were assigned with no grant of any kind, and 37 of their form obligations are under a live grant held by DISC and SRC lanes. Either grants are minted for a c3 lane or the cohort is withdrawn; a worker cannot mint its own.

The six Spanish and Vietnamese informational copies. The English editions are already in the library with hashes recorded below. This is a one-line substitution in whatever produced corpusCandidates, and until it is made the same wrong file will be offered to the next worker.

The ten source-gated candidates. Governing rule 6 forbids the packet resolver from selecting them. Lifting that for a specific asset is a deliberate act with an author; leaving it means those forms are acquisitions.
The three encrypted California XFA forms. They cannot be filled as AcroForms and their permission flags forbid modification. This needs an acquisition of open bytes or an explicit determination.

Whether corpusCandidates should be regenerated at all. Of 224 named form obligations it supplied a correct, attachable candidate for a minority; it also missed 13 forms that ARE in the library, including every English North Carolina edition. A generator that matches a filename and ignores language, jurisdiction, corpus tier and statutory section will keep producing this.
